```{r}
library(httr)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}

api_key <- Sys.getenv("NPS_api_key")
# Example: Get alerts for Acadia and Denali parks
req <- request("https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/parks") |> 
  req_url_query(limit = 500, api_key = api_key)

resp <- req_perform(req)

# Parse the JSON response into an R list/data frame
data <- resp |> 
  resp_body_string() |> 
  fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

# View alerts data frame
parks <- data$data
```

```{r}
location <- parks |>
  select(fullName,parkCode,longitude, latitude)
```


```{r}
activities <- parks |>
  select(fullName,activities)|>
  unnest(activities)
```

```{r}
fees <- parks |>
  select(fullName,entranceFees)|>
  unnest(entranceFees)
```

```{r}
passes <- parks |>
  select(fullName,entrancePasses)|>
  unnest(entrancePasses)
```

```{r}
hours <- parks |>
  select(fullName, operatingHours)|>
  unnest(operatingHours)
```
